description: This Java class implements character escaping according to RFC 8259 for JSON strings, handling control characters, quotes, backslashes, and special Unicode characters for line and paragraph breaks.

classes.name: JsonCharEscaper
classes.description: A singleton class that provides JSON character escaping functionality, converting characters into their escaped Unicode or special sequence forms where necessary.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Provides the singleton instance of JsonCharEscaper.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Escapes the given character if necessary according to JSON escaping rules.
